supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded creation of ext.rwong by nora.blake at 13:44:07 UTC.
The account was added to the Freelancers group shortly after creation by nora.blake.

The account-creation event uses the same logon ID as nora.blake's network logon to the domain controller from WS-NBLAKE-01, supporting that the creation was performed through that workstation session.
The account name and Freelancers membership are consistent with the supplied help-desk temporary-account practice, but this consistency does not establish that the request was authorized.
Cisco AnyConnect's vpnui.exe was launched by nora.blake on WS-NBLAKE-01 after account creation; a Cisco-signed vpnapi.dll was loaded.
The supplied environment context says VPN is not approved, making the AnyConnect launch noteworthy; these process and module records do not establish that a VPN connection was made.
UserAssist registry entries record run paths for Chrome, Word, and Excel during the review window, but do not establish what content was accessed or whether it was related to the account creation.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor status reports a proxy log-collection outage from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the account creation and AnyConnect launch; proxy activity in that interval cannot be assessed from the supplied records.
The supplied records do not include a VPN connection event or a corresponding successful remote session; the AnyConnect process launch alone does not establish either.
claims_not_established: Whether ext.rwong was requested and approved, or whether the account was used after creation.
Whether AnyConnect established a VPN connection or was merely launched.
Whether there was unapproved network, file-sharing, or remote-access activity during the proxy collection outage.
Whether ext.rwong received any additional group memberships or privileges beyond what is shown in the supplied records.
additional_evidence_needed: Validate the account request or ticket and confirm with nora.blake that she created ext.rwong for an authorized purpose.
Review ext.rwong's subsequent sign-ins, group memberships, privilege changes, and activity on domain systems.
Collect AnyConnect client logs and configuration, plus available endpoint, firewall, Zeek, and proxy records, to determine whether a VPN or other external connection was established.
Recover or otherwise investigate proxy activity for 13:30–14:10 UTC if retained elsewhere.
